_note: Provisional regression ceilings, set from runs on fizlet main 652455e (0.15.0) on a 4-core Xeon 2.8 GHz, Chromium 153, 4x CPU throttle, 10 s: demo p50 33.4 (one run 50.0), p95 50.1-83.3, p99 83.3-100 ms, 55-66% dropped, FCP 308-1384 ms, heap 2.7-3.4 MB, 0-2 minor GC.
